items.exampleEn: After months of confinement, the animals were released into the wild.
items.exampleZh: 被關了好幾個月之後，這些動物被放回了野外。

items.exampleEn: The school's strict uniform rules encourage conformity.
items.exampleZh: 學校嚴格的制服規定助長了從眾的風氣。

items.exampleEn: He forfeited his deposit when he canceled the trip.
items.exampleZh: 他取消了旅行，因此失去了訂金。

items.exampleEn: For centuries, farmers persecuted wolves because they feared them.
items.exampleZh: 好幾個世紀以來，農民因為害怕狼而迫害牠們。

items.exampleEn: The manager lost his job after being found guilty of bribery.
items.exampleZh: 那位經理被判賄賂罪之後，丟了工作。

items.exampleEn: The gang was arrested for the extortion of local shop owners.
items.exampleZh: 那個幫派因為向當地店家勒索而被逮捕。

items.exampleEn: She was justly proud of her children.
items.exampleZh: 她理所當然地以孩子們為傲。

items.exampleEn: The office is run very bureaucratically, with forms for everything.
items.exampleZh: 這間辦公室的運作非常官僚，什麼事都要填表。

items.sentenceEn: The judge treated everyone in the court justly.
items.sentenceZh: 法官公正地對待法庭上的每一個人。

items.audioEn: For Tom, two weeks of confinement to bed with a broken leg felt like a year.
items.audioZh: 對 Tom 來說，因為腿骨折而臥床兩週，感覺像過了一年。

items.sentenceEn: The team forfeited the game because two players were sick.
items.sentenceZh: 因為兩名球員生病，球隊棄權輸掉了比賽。

items.sentenceEn: The police are looking into a case of extortion at the market.
items.sentenceZh: 警方正在調查市場裡的一起勒索案。

items.stemEn: Paying an officer to ignore a problem is a form of ____.
items.stemZh: 付錢給官員，讓他對問題視而不見，是一種賄賂行為。

items.stemEn: Students here feel a lot of pressure toward ____, so few dare to look different.
items.stemZh: 這裡的學生承受很大的從眾壓力，所以很少人敢與眾不同。

items.passageEn: Last week, our class visited an old prison that is now a museum. The guide showed us the tiny, somber cells where prisoners spent years in confinement. Some of them had been persecuted for their beliefs, while others had been jailed for crimes such as extortion. The prison was run bureaucratically: every meal, letter and visit was written down in thick books. A prisoner who broke a rule could forfeit his weekly visit from family. At the end of the tour, the guide asked us whether all of these people had been treated justly.
items.passageZh: 上週，我們班參觀了一座已改成博物館的舊監獄。導覽員帶我們看狹小又陰暗的牢房，囚犯們曾在裡面被關了好幾年。他們當中有些人是因為自己的信念而遭到迫害，有些人則是因為勒索之類的罪行而入獄。這座監獄的管理方式非常官僚：每一餐、每封信和每次探視都寫在厚厚的冊子裡。違反規定的囚犯，可能會失去每週一次的家人探視。參觀結束時，導覽員問我們，這些人是否都受到了公正的對待。

questions.questionZh: 囚犯違反規定會怎麼樣？
options: 必須寫一封很長的道歉信給家人

questions.questionZh: 參觀結束時，導覽員問了什麼？
options: 大家最喜歡監獄裡的哪一間牢房
這些人是否受到公正對待
有沒有人以後想當博物館導覽員

items.promptZh: 如果你沒有準時報到，就會喪失比賽資格。
referenceEn: Your place in the race will be forfeited if you do not check in on time.
Runners who check in late will forfeit their place in the race.
rubricZh: forfeit 是及物動詞，表示「喪失、被沒收」（例如 forfeit your place、forfeit the deposit 等）
「準時報到」可寫，例如 check in on time、arrive on time 等
「比賽資格」可寫，例如 your place in the race、the right to compete 等

items.instructionZh: 用 conformity 造一個句子，說說你對「跟大家都一樣」的看法或經驗。
referenceEn: I think too much conformity makes school life boring.
In my class, there is a lot of conformity in the way people dress.
rubricZh: conformity 是不可數名詞，表示「從眾、與他人一致」（例如 too much conformity、conformity in dress 等）
句子要說到你自己的看法或經驗

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：聽選正解「For a week, until it could fly」唯一帶補充說明、長度約為其他選項平均 1.96 倍，長度與具體程度洩題（§11-24）。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 聽選依第③關 A 建議改成囚犯被關十二年；選項重寫，正解不再帶補充說明，並改為第 3 長

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：兩小題正解（「可能失去每週一次的家人探視機會」「這些人是否都受到了公正的對待」）都是該題唯一最長選項（約 1.7 倍），本課選擇題正解有 3 題是最長選項，長度名次偏斜。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 兩小題正解縮短改寫，干擾項加長，正解分別改為第 2、第 3 長

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：疑似：bribery 兼指行賄與受賄，「被判行賄罪」限定為行賄；釋義「行賄；賄賂行為」亦同，可改「賄賂罪」。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 例句中譯改「賄賂罪」，釋義改「賄賂行為；行賄、受賄」，mcq 釋義同步

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關 A：聽選與 confinement 卡同情境（動物被關後放回）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 音檔改 The prisoner was finally set free after twelve years in confinement.

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關 A 疑似 10：bribery 卡與 mcq 都是「因行賄受罰」
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 題幹改 Paying an officer to ignore a problem is a form of ____.

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關 A 疑似 12：forfeit 卡寫訂房退款規定（具體規定，§11.21）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改中性句 He forfeited his deposit when he canceled the trip.

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關：評分要點有「可寫 X 等」沒有「例如」、「常用 X」或寫死位置、時態（§11.23）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依執行長裁示統一改成「例如…等」或「X 的用法，例如…等」：forfeit 是及物動詞，表示「喪失、被沒收」（例如 forfeit your place、forfeit the deposit 等）／「準時報到」可寫，例如 check in on time、arrive on time 等／「比賽資格」可寫，例如 your place in the race、the right to compete 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長最終複審修正：最終複審 5：persecute 卡與同課閱讀都是被動式「因信念受迫害」，同單元 Galileo 卡也是同類事件
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 卡改 For centuries, farmers persecuted wolves because they feared them.

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長最終複審修正：最終複審 6：聽選音檔與 confinement 卡都是「關一段時間後被釋放」，同課閱讀也寫囚犯被關
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 音檔改用「限制」義 For Tom, two weeks of confinement to bed with a broken leg felt like a year.；題目與選項重寫，正解仍是第 3 長、位置不動
